name: envelope-printer
description: Print addresses on envelopes from a list or spreadsheet, at the real envelope size.

interface.longDescription:
Print envelopes with addresses at home. Paste your address list, attach a CSV or Excel spreadsheet, or type the names, and get a PDF with one page per envelope at the real size of the envelope you have, ready to feed into your printer.

What you get
- One PDF page per envelope at the real size: #10 business envelopes (4 1/8 x 9 1/2 in), #9, #6 3/4, Monarch, A2, A6, A7 invitation envelopes (5 1/4 x 7 1/4 in), A9, 6x9, 9x12, 10x13, and DL, C6, C5 and C4 envelopes, or a custom size in inches or mm
- Your return address in the top-left corner and each delivery address placed inside the USPS read area, clear of the stamp corner and the barcode strip
- Addresses abroad (written in Latin letters) in the destination country's line order: postcode before the city for Germany or France, the postcode on its own line for the UK, and the country name last in capitals. The country line is left off for mail inside your own country
- Print envelopes from Excel: name, street, city, state and ZIP columns are found from the headings of Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy and Shopify exports, and ZIP codes that lost a leading zero in Excel get it back
- Each address gets its own envelope. Long lines wrap or shrink to fit (a line over 600 characters is shortened and flagged), and missing ZIP codes, unknown states, repeated addresses and lines that had to wrap are listed for you to check
- A test page to print on plain paper first, and a Letter or A4 sheet mode for printers that cannot take a custom paper size
- A CSV of all envelopes and their problems
- Which envelope fits a 5x7 card, an RSVP card or a letter folded in thirds, with the size in inches and mm and the USPS mail size (letter or large envelope)

Names in Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Vietnamese letters and common Chinese characters print on the envelope.

This plugin prints the addresses. It does not buy postage, print stamps or barcodes, check that an address exists, or print label sheets.

Known limits. Up to 1,000 envelopes per PDF. Korean, Hebrew and rare Chinese characters are marked (see CSV), emoji are left out of the PDF, and Arabic letter joining is basic. Printers feed envelopes in different ways, so print the test page first and follow the envelope icon on your tray.
defaultPrompt: Print #10 envelopes for Jane Smith, 123 Main St Apt 4B, Springfield IL 62704 from 42 Oak Lane, Portland OR 97205
Print A7 envelopes for my wedding invitations from this guest list
What size envelope do I need for a 5x7 card?

positive.description: Two #10 envelopes with a return address
positive.prompt: Print #10 envelopes for Jane Smith, 123 Main St Apt 4B, Springfield IL 62704 and Raj Patel, 9 Elm Rd, Austin TX 78701 from The Garcia Family, 42 Oak Lane, Portland OR 97205
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_envelope_pdf with the 2 recipients, return address The Garcia Family, 42 Oak Lane, Portland, OR 97205 and envelope_size 10. Returns a PDF of 3 pages (a test page, then one #10 page per envelope) with 123 Main St Apt 4B, Springfield, IL 62704 and 9 Elm Rd, Austin, TX 78701, and a CSV.

positive.prompt: What size envelope do I need for a 5x7 card?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_envelope_size with the query 5x7 card. Lists the A7 envelope (5 1/4 x 7 1/4 in) first with 0.25 x 0.25 in to spare, then larger envelopes that also fit.

positive.description: A7 invitation envelopes with one address in Canada
positive.prompt: Print A7 envelopes for Ana Lopez, 77 Pine St, Denver CO 80203; Tom Reed, 5 Lake Rd, Madison WI 53703; Mia Chen, 300 Bay St, Toronto ON M5J 2R8, Canada
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_envelope_pdf with the 3 recipients and envelope_size A7. Returns 3 envelopes of 5 1/4 x 7 1/4 in; the Toronto address ends with the line CANADA and the US addresses have no country line (80203, 53703).

positive.description: DL envelope from the UK to Germany
positive.prompt: DL envelope from Olivia Brown, 1 High St, Oxford OX1 4AA, UK to Hans Müller, Hauptstr. 5, 10115 Berlin, Germany
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_envelope_pdf with the recipient, the UK return address and envelope_size DL. Returns one DL envelope (110 x 220 mm) with the lines Hans Müller, Hauptstr. 5, 10115 Berlin and GERMANY.

positive.description: Envelope for A4 folded in thirds
positive.prompt: Which envelope fits an A4 letter folded in thirds?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_envelope_size with the query A4 letter folded in thirds. Lists the DL envelope (110 x 220 mm) first with 0.433 x 0.394 in to spare, then the #10 envelope.

negative.prompt: Buy postage and print a USPS shipping label for my package
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the tools. This plugin prints addresses on envelopes and does not buy postage or make shipping labels.

negative.prompt: Write the wording for a wedding invitation
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call generate_envelope_pdf or find_envelope_size. Writing invitation text is a writing task, not envelope printing.

negative.prompt: What is the ZIP code for 1600 Pennsylvania Ave in Washington?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the tools. The plugin does not look up or verify addresses or ZIP codes.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: envelope PDFs at the real envelope size (#10, #9, #6 3/4, Monarch, A2, A6, A7, A9, 6x9, 9x12, 10x13, DL, C6, C5, C4, custom) from a pasted list, typed names or a CSV/Excel file, with return address, country line order for mail abroad, a test page, a CSV of problems, and an envelope size finder.

pl-PL.subtitle: Adresy na kopertach do druku
pl-PL.description: Drukuj adresy na kopertach w domu. Wklej listę adresów, dołącz plik CSV lub Excel albo wpisz nazwiska i otrzymaj PDF z jedną stroną na kopertę w rzeczywistym rozmiarze koperty: DL, C6, C5, C4, #10, A7 i inne lub własny rozmiar. Adres zwrotny w lewym górnym rogu, adres odbiorcy w kolejności linii kraju docelowego, nazwa kraju tylko dla przesyłek za granicę. Każdy adres dostaje swoją kopertę, a brakujące kody pocztowe i zawinięte linie są wypisane do sprawdzenia.

de-DE.subtitle: Adressen auf Umschläge drucken
de-DE.description: Drucke Adressen zu Hause auf Briefumschläge. Füge eine Adressliste ein, hänge eine CSV- oder Excel-Datei an oder tippe die Namen, und du erhältst ein PDF mit einer Seite pro Umschlag in der echten Umschlaggröße: DL, C6, C5, C4, #10, A7 und weitere oder eine eigene Größe. Absender oben links, Empfänger in der Zeilenfolge des Ziellandes, Ländername nur bei Post ins Ausland. Jede Adresse bekommt ihren Umschlag; fehlende Postleitzahlen und umbrochene Zeilen werden zur Prüfung aufgelistet.

es-ES.subtitle: Imprime direcciones en sobres
es-ES.description: Imprime direcciones en sobres en casa. Pega tu lista de direcciones, adjunta un archivo CSV o Excel o escribe los nombres, y obtén un PDF con una página por sobre al tamaño real del sobre: DL, C6, C5, C4, #10, A7 y otros, o un tamaño personalizado. Remitente en la esquina superior izquierda, destinatario en el orden de líneas del país de destino y el país solo para envíos al extranjero. Cada dirección tiene su sobre y los códigos postales que faltan se listan para revisar.

fr-FR.subtitle: Imprimer des enveloppes
fr-FR.description: Imprimez les adresses sur vos enveloppes à la maison. Collez votre liste d'adresses, joignez un fichier CSV ou Excel ou tapez les noms, et obtenez un PDF avec une page par enveloppe au format réel : DL, C6, C5, C4, #10, A7 et d'autres, ou un format personnalisé. Expéditeur en haut à gauche, destinataire dans l'ordre des lignes du pays de destination, pays seulement pour l'étranger. Chaque adresse a son enveloppe et les codes postaux manquants sont listés pour vérification.

ja-JP.subtitle: 封筒に宛名を印刷
ja-JP.description: 封筒への宛名印刷を自宅で。住所リストを貼り付けるか、CSVやExcelファイルを添付するか、名前を入力すると、DL、C6、C5、C4、#10、A7などの実寸の封筒サイズ（またはカスタムサイズ）で1封筒1ページのPDFを作成します。差出人は左上、宛先は宛先国の行順で配置し、国名は海外宛てのときだけ入れます。すべての住所に封筒を作り、郵便番号の欠けや折り返した行は確認用に一覧にします。

pt-BR.subtitle: Imprima endereços em envelopes
pt-BR.description: Imprima endereços em envelopes em casa. Cole sua lista de endereços, anexe um arquivo CSV ou Excel ou digite os nomes e receba um PDF com uma página por envelope no tamanho real: DL, C6, C5, C4, #10, A7 e outros, ou um tamanho personalizado. Remetente no canto superior esquerdo, destinatário na ordem de linhas do país de destino e o país só para envios ao exterior. Cada endereço ganha seu envelope e os CEPs que faltam são listados para conferência.
